name: angular-ddd
description: Domain-Driven Design for Angular/TypeScript: functional patterns with `type` aliases, `readonly` fields, pure rule functions, immutable value types, branded IDs, and ports as abstract classes. Use when creating or reviewing domain models, aggregates, rule functions, ports, bounded contexts, or domain events. Use when enforcing aggregate invariants, applying DDD tactical patterns, mapping bounded contexts, or integrating with event sourcing. Provides tactical-pattern guidance, strategic-design rules, an event-sourcing→flurryx mapping, and a file:line review checklist. Complements angular-clean-architecture (folder layout/layering/DI) and flurryx (store/replay mechanics).
